label: Groups as channel strips
help: Each group on a strip: its level, select, the encoder page and flash.

label: Fixtures as channel strips
help: Each fixture on a strip: its level, select, the encoder page and flash.

label: The selection, one head per strip
help: The first selected heads, in rig order, one a strip. A select button narrows the selection to that head.

label: Cue stacks as playbacks
help: Fader is the stack's FX amount, flash is GO, select is Back.

label: Speed masters
help: Fader is the master's tempo across 20–300 BPM, flash is Tap.

label: Wheels on the selection
help: Each encoder one function: a level, a colour axis, a fan, FX speed or a tempo.

label: Wheels by encoder page
help: The first selected heads, in rig order, one an encoder, each on the attribute the encoder page names.

label: Palettes onto the selection
help: Each button presses a palette on the selection.

label: The busk page that's showing
help: Its first pads in order. A page button moves it, and the row follows.

label: GO for each cue stack
help: Each button is a stack's GO.

label: Looks
help: Each button puts a Look on, or takes it off.

label: Encoder pages
help: Each button points the device's encoders at an attribute, lit while it is the page.

label: Transport for one stack
help: GO, Back, Stop, Pause, Tap and Clear, in that order, for one stack.

label: Programmer keys
help: Clear, Blind, Undo, Release, Locate and Clear selection, in that order, on the selection.

label: Grand master and blackout
help: The fader is the grand master, its select button blackout.
